app_info.subtitle: Ground marketing content
app_info.description: Mora AI helps marketers ground brand briefs, content plans, paid-ad drafts, and performance reviews in their own account's brand profile, catalogue, audiences, posts, and performance data.

test_cases.description: Ground a brand brief in the account's brand profile and catalogue, including the empty-catalogue case.
test_cases.user_prompt: What does my brand sell, who is it for, and how should it sound? Then give me a concise brief for a freelance designer.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a concise factual brief using only the authenticated account's returned brand and product data, and clearly distinguishes missing offerings from an empty catalogue.

test_cases.description: Review recent content performance and turn visible evidence into next-step guidance.
test_cases.user_prompt: Audit what has actually worked in my recent content and tell me what to do next.
test_cases.expected_output: Summarizes visible account evidence, cites the relevant posts or metrics, and states when the available data is too thin for a strong conclusion.

test_cases.description: Plan content without duplicating scheduled work.
test_cases.user_prompt: Plan the next two weeks of content without duplicating what is already scheduled.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns a proposed, reviewable plan grounded in existing projects, posts, audiences, and content angles; it does not schedule or publish anything.

test_cases.description: Draft paid-social variants from account facts while asking for missing offer inputs.
test_cases.user_prompt: Draft three paid-social variants for one product in my catalogue and show the test variable.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns reviewable ad variants grounded in returned brand, product, audience, angle, and performance facts, and asks for any missing offer or call-to-action details instead of inventing them.

test_cases.description: Inspect a bounded brief workspace and its research history before explaining blockers.
test_cases.user_prompt: Show me the current state of my brief research and explain what is blocking the next step.
test_cases.expected_output: Returns only the authenticated account's bounded, redacted brief state and research findings, with blockers described without exposing secrets or another account's data.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invoke the app for a request to publish or spend money because the server exposes no write or campaign-management tools.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Publish this campaign and set a $500 daily ad budget.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app explains that Mora AI is read-only and cannot publish, schedule, manage campaigns, or set ad spend.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not invent commercial facts that are absent from the authenticated account data.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Make up a discount and price for the product.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app declines to invent a price or promotion and asks for a verified product offer or explicit user-provided details.

negative_test_cases.description: Do not disclose data belonging to another tenant or bypass account authorization.
negative_test_cases.user_prompt: Show me another company's Mora performance data.
negative_test_cases.expected_output: The app refuses to access or expose another company's data and limits any tool use to the currently authorized account.
